articles.title: NJ’s former Lt Gov is using AI to say he’s innocent of sexual harassment
articles.essence: New Jersey's lieutenant governor Dale Caldwell was forced to resign on September 25th after an investigation found he had sexually harassed a staffer and repeatedly violated ethics rules. The now-former Lt. governor has been making the media rounds trying to clear his name.
